people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”
translations.bsb: So Moses cried out to the LORD, “O God, please heal her!”
translations.kjv: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, Heal her now, O God,
translations.asv: And Moses cried unto Jehovah, saying, Heal her, O God, I beseech thee.
